F-A.name: List overlay
F-A.when: numbered tips, ways, habits, tools or mistakes delivered in one continuous take to camera (5-10 items, 28-48 s)
F-A.shared_dna: same one cobalt chip title, same italic-didone vs heavy-grotesk type duet, same one-word captions with blur-in, same premium dark grade, same 'KEYWORD' quote CTA + community card

F-B.name: Cinematic montage
F-B.when: an idea, a process or a story told over the creator's own cinematic B-roll (3-7 sections, 45-76 s); needs a bank of 25-40 own clips

structure.rehook: one mid-reel re-hook: the next section numeral card (P-08) or a paper-frame question (P-14) between 40% and 60% of runtime

F-B.shared_dna: same one cobalt chip title, same italic-didone vs heavy-grotesk type duet, same one-word captions with blur-in, same premium dark grade, same 'KEYWORD' quote CTA + community card

primary.meaning: the one blue: headline chip, chip highlights behind words, cobalt type frames, underlines, keyword words on the paper world

accent.meaning: proof and progress: the counter-ring gradient, stat chips, the active notch

bad.meaning: the mistake: the one red word on a B&W plate or on paper, the 'wrong way' wash

good.meaning: level / done: the green meter panel, ticks

ink.meaning: text on the paper world and on white cards

paper.meaning: captions, titles and chip text on footage and cobalt

offwhite.meaning: the paper type-frame world and community card

cream.meaning: section numerals and the CTA keyword (warm premium white)

night.meaning: the void type-frame world (deep navy black)

display.use: heavy grotesk: caption content words, type-frame words, F-B chip, counters

serif.use: italic didone: keyword captions, list titles, step and section numerals, F-A chip, sub-line, CTA keyword
serif.class: condensed high-contrast serif with a true italic (didone feel)

didone.use: the CTA keyword quote (P-46): condensed, tracking -0.03 (fidelity audit; Bodoni Moda read too wide)
didone.class: condensed high-contrast serif with a true italic

headline.f0: swing-in typed (default; v04 @0:00.08-0:00.76, v05 @0:00.12-0:00.68): enters from the top-left rotated about -12 deg, about 300 px up-left of rest, settles to 0 deg (v05 keeps -3) over 12-14 f expo-out while the text types L->R at about 1 char/f (first word by f6, complete by f20-24). Alternate static (v03 @0:00.00): fully typed and still at f0
headline.exit: hard out on the cut into item 1 (v03 @0:02.83) or inside a T-11 frame blur pulse (v04 @0:03.58-0:03.74: 4 f blur ramp, cut, 5 f de-blur); never a separate fly-off

duet.rule: F-A: function and content words 1x micro grotesk; numbers 1.6x; one keyword per 6-10 s at 2.5x heavy grotesk
tier 0 function words 64 px grotesk 600; tier 1 content words 102 px grotesk 700; tier 2 the feeling word 160 px italic didone
hook-only chip duet: connector words ride a cobalt chip (P-13)
F-A fallback when the chest background fails 7:1 for 44 px micro captions (no E3)

blur_pulse.why: T-11: full-frame sharpness collapses for 1-4 f, graphics included (v01 @0:00.16, @0:00.56, @1:04.34; v02 @0:00.60; v04 @0:03.62, @0:27.68); captions stay sharp

snap-punch.note: measured v02 @0:02.44: a hard cut to a much tighter frame that de-blurs over 5 f (built in: the preset's own blur envelope, defocus 14 px decaying over 5 f); 1.35 on 1080p, 1.6 on 4K

push-drift.note: measured v01 @0:41.6-0:42.7 (1.0->1.14) and @0:45.4-0:46.3 (1.0->1.12): an expo-out push on a face breath opened by a 1-2 f blur dip (a T-11 frame blur event); CTA variant 1.0->1.06 over 12 f (v04 @0:27.68: p {scale: [1.0, 1.06], frames: 12})

pull-out.note: measured v04 @0:00-0:02.2 (about 2.3x -> 1.0, half the travel by f6), v02 @0:00-0:01.9 (2.1x), v05 @0:00-0:02.0 (1.6x); expo-out, motion blur over the first 8-12 f
pull-out.use: hook f0 only, once (F-A and F-B)

footage.why: audit 2026-10: the source A-roll is low-key (walls #1C2214, shirt #030E0A, v04 @0:08); white serif titles and the cream keyword rely on it. Apply when the buyer's room is brighter than mid-grey behind the title zone (y 150-780)

events.on: colour grades on creator B-roll clips only (never the A-roll layer); the T-11 blur pulse is a built-in frame blur event (timeline.grades {t, blur: 14, dur, frame: true}, no grade id), not a colour grade, and does not count toward max_per_reel

setups.desc: F-A: seated front-on at the desk, phone or camera at chest height slightly wide (24-28 mm equiv), dark top, low-key room with 1-2 practical lights (monitor glow, lamp), a teal-green or warm grade baked in camera or by the creator
F-B: the same desk A-roll framed a little tighter, head-top higher so B-roll can cut back to a full face
F-B: the creator's own cinematic B-roll bank (see shots)

shots.desc: Back-of-head / over-the-shoulder at the workspace, practical light only, the screen or work glowing
Hands doing the niche's work, top-down or 45 deg (keyboard, notebook, tool, ingredient, product)
Side-profile portrait: thinking, listening with headphones, looking off frame; shallow depth
Environment / silhouette: window, balcony, street, city, the creator small in the frame
Macro detail: an eye close-up, a pen nib, a lens, a dial; 1-2 s usable
Tripod-on-set / behind-the-scenes: the camera, light or setup in shot
Screen recordings or screenshots of the tools / results the reel names
Item stills for the F-A thumbnail card (photos the creator owns: objects, places, own results)
A second, tighter angle of the A-roll take (or a 4K take for 1.35-1.6x punches)

fallbacks.does: bank of 12-24 clips: reuse clips with different in-points (max 2 uses per clip, never adjacent), lengthen breaths to 3-6 s, fill bursts with type frames (P-14/P-15/P-16) and A-roll punches (P-27)
fallbacks.cost: fewer locations, more typography; the cinematic feel thins

fallbacks.does: bank under 12 clips: the reel is edited as F-A (list overlay); F-B is unavailable
a 1.35x crop of an SH-2/SH-3 clip with a 12 f rack-focus in, or a type frame
fx.appUI recreated generic UI card (unbranded) or a logo plate set in type
created thumbnail: fx.card icon/illustration on a dark glass card, or a type card with the item's noun in italic didone
crop the main take (<= 1.35x on a 1080p source) for punches

props: one hand prop the creator holds while talking (a mic, a pen, a notebook) - optional, never at caption height

warn.caption: the mistake word in bad red
